interpretation_rules: Entries group linked investigations, not independent tasks or observations.
Do not sum overlapping compiler test suites or repeated task attempts as independent samples.
Unknown agent-level effects are not zero effects.
Preserve original task/attempt denominators, versions, failures, corrections and unmeasured outcomes.
Public development fixtures are excluded from claims of unseen confirmatory evaluation.
